_comment: Scanner thresholds and toggles. Edit here, or from the dashboard's
settings view (`c`), which writes this same file.
minConfidence  Signals below this are not reported. Confidence is a
heuristic ranking aid built from named components, NOT a
probability: 8 means 'look at this first', not '80% likely'.
sectorFocus    Empty means every sector. Add sector names from your
watchlist to narrow what gets reported.
useStockTwits  StockTwits is an undocumented public API with no stability
guarantee. Set false to skip social signals entirely.
See docs/scanner.md for what each threshold actually does.
